FIDE Sends Carlsen to the Ethics Commission as Total Chess Turns Political
rubriker._rss_content: FIDE has referred Carlsen to its Ethics Commission over Total Chess forfeits. Rosenstein defends him and attacks Turlov, and arbiters face review too.

rubriker.title: Firouzja beats Giri in Armageddon to claim Total Chess Pilot title
rubriker._rss_content: Alireza Firouzja won the Total Chess Pilot in Budapest on Friday, defeating Anish Giri in Armageddon after the finalists had exchanged set victories. Fabiano Caruana secured third place with a straight-sets win over Maxime Vachier-Lagrave, while Hans Niemann finished fifth. Meanwhile, Magnus Carlsen forfeited a game for the fourth consecutive day before claiming seventeenth place. His decisions continued to draw criticism as the experimental tournament came to an end. | Photo: Michal Walusza / Total Chess

rubriker.title: Firouzja supera a Giri en la partida a muerte súbita y gana el Total Chess Pilot en Budapest
rubriker._rss_content: Alireza Firouzja se proclamó vencedor del Total Chess Pilot en Budapest tras derrotar a Anish Giri en Armagedón después de que cada uno de los finalistas ganara un set en el match por el título. Fabiano Caruana se quedó con el tercer puesto tras vencer a Maxime Vachier-Lagrave en dos sets, mientras que Hans Niemann terminó quinto. Por su parte, Magnus Carlsen perdió una partida por incomparecencia por cuarto día consecutivo antes de adjudicarse el decimoséptimo puesto. Sus decisiones generaron críticas por parte de jugadores y autoridades. | Foto: Michal Walusza / Total Chess

Casablanca and Oromana take early lead at Spanish Team Championship
rubriker._rss_content: MyInvestor Casablanca and Oromana Cen Solutions are the only teams to have won both their matches after two rounds of the Spanish Team Championship in Marbella. Casablanca lead the standings on tiebreaks following a convincing 5–1 victory over Silla Bosch Serinsys, while Oromana edged out Jaime Casas de Monzón. The eight-team competition features a strong international field, including Nihal Sarin, Parham Maghsoodloo (pictured), Nodirbek Yakubboev and Alexei Shirov. | Photo: Spanish Chess Federation
